title: RBACv2 phased migration: fallback-first rollout, audit-preservation, and customer ops briefing
creator: Ravi Kapoor
description: Goal: Execute a phased RBAC v1 -> RBAC v2 migration that prioritizes safe rollback, audit-log fidelity, and clear customer operations runbooks. Approach: deploy a fallback-first dual-write adapter, run backfills with live discrepancy monitoring, and perform a controlled single-source cutover only after telemetry gates and customer opt-ins. This ticket coordinates engineering work, customer communications, on-call runbooks, and SSO/SAML mapping verification.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write shim deployed to write v1 and v2 payloads with tombstone markers and idempotency keys
Backfill job can catch up within 48 hours for typical orgs and exposes progress percent and ETA
Discrepancy telemetry: organ-level permission mismatches < 0.1% for 24h on canary orgs
Audit log continuity verified: every authorization decision emitted to audit-stream before and after cutover with persistent event IDs
SAML NameID / attributes mapping test suite passes for 100% of mapped attributes for our 5 largest SSO customers
Operator rollback path demonstrates returning to RBAC v1 for a canary org within 15 minutes without losing admin access
Customer communications templates prepared and a staged opt-in flow exists in Console
tasks: Implement dual-write adapter: include idempotency, tombstone flag, and write-order guarantees
Build backfill worker with windowed checkpoints and rate-limiting by org
Create discrepancy detector service (sampling + full-compare for canaries)
Add audit-stream enrichment: add pre_migration_id and migration_marker to each event
SAML mapping verification harness and synthetic SSO tests
Console: per-org migration status page and opt-in control
Runbook: emergency admin bridge CLI and 'org-pause' feature for paused migrations
Prepare customer comms drafts and internal FAQ for CSMs
